sentences.text:
Counsel for Respondent :- G.A.
Hon'ble Vivek Kumar Birla,J.
Hon'ble Vinod Diwakar,J.
1. Heard Sri Pankaj Kumar Yadav holding brief of Ms. Mamta Singh, learned counsel for the
petitioners and Sri Balram Mishra, learned counsel for the informant whose Vakalatnama filed
today is taken on record and Sri G.P. Singh, learned Aga appearing for the State respondents.

2. Present petition has been filed with the prayer to quash the impugned first information report
dated 25.07.2023, registered as Case Crime No.0757 of 2023, under Sections 323, 498A, 313 Ipc
and Section 3/4 D.P. Act, and Section 3, 5(1) of Uttar Pradesh Illegal Conversion Act, Police Station
Prabhakar And Another vs State Of U.P. And 2 Others on 18 August, 2023

Khalilabad, District Sant Kabir Nagar.

Further, the petitioners are seeking a direction in the nature
of mandamus commanding the respondents not to arrest the petitioners pursuant to said Fir.
3.
After some arguments, learned counsel for the petitioners submitted that he may be permitted to withdraw the present petition.
5. Accordingly, present petition stands dismissed as withdrawn.
